data.title: From nothing to tickets on sale in one evening.
data.lead: Seven steps, about forty minutes of setup, and a person on WhatsApp if you get stuck. Here’s everything between downloading Catch Host and the morning after your first event.

data.title: What to do, and how long it takes.

items.label: Download Catch Host
items.body: Catch Host is the app you run everything from. It’s free on iPhone and Android.
tips: Sign in with your phone number
Add anyone who helps you run events later

items.label: Make your page
items.body: Your page is where people find you, follow you and book. Give it your name, a photo and a line about what you do.
tips: Use the photo people already know you by
Add your Instagram so people can check you’re real
Already listed on Catch? Claim your page instead

items.label: Create your first event
items.body: Pick the format closest to your night. It fills in the door, the groups and the run of show; you add the date, place, price and capacity.
tips: Set a cancellation policy now, not after the first request
Turn on applications if you want to approve each guest
Add a waitlist so drop-outs get filled

items.label: Connect payments
items.body: Connect a Razorpay account so guests can pay by UPI or card, and the money comes to you. KYC can take [1–2 working days], so do this early.
tips: Have your PAN and bank details ready
Free events don’t need payments set up
Payment gateway fees are separate from Catch’s 5%

items.label: Share your links
items.body: Make a link for each place you’ll share the event: your Instagram bio, each WhatsApp group, each friend bringing people.
tips: Catch shows visits and bookings for every link
Followers hear about the event without you posting

items.label: Run the door
items.body: Open the door in Catch Host. Guests scan in; you see who’s here, who’s late and who’s new.
tips: Decide how many walk-ins you’ll take
A co-host can run the door on their own phone
Messages to everyone go out from the app

items.label: Follow up
items.body: Send photos and a thank-you, ask for a review and put the next date up while people still want it.
tips: Everyone who came can follow you
Your report shows who came, who didn’t and where bookings came from

steps.d: Most bookings for a first event come in the last week, but the people who book early bring friends. Turn on early-bird pricing if you want them to.

steps.t: Share it everywhere you already are
steps.d: One link in your Instagram bio, one for each WhatsApp group, one for each friend who promised to bring people. Catch shows which one works.
Where to be, when, and what to bring goes out by itself. Check your door list and how many walk-ins you can take.

steps.t: Open the door on your phone
steps.d: Guests scan in. You see who’s here, who’s late and who’s new, then put the phone away and host.

steps.t: Thank them and set the next date
steps.d: Photos and a thank-you go out. Everyone who came can follow you, and they hear about the next one first.

data.title: What new hosts ask us.
items: Do I need a registered business?
No. You can host as an individual. To take payments you’ll need a Razorpay account, which works for individuals with a PAN and a bank account.
How long until I can sell tickets?
Your page and event take about twenty minutes. Paid tickets go on sale once Razorpay finishes its checks, usually [1–2 working days]. Free events can go live straight away.
Nothing for 30 days from your first event, or 90 for founding hosts. Then 5% of ticket sales, never more than ₹10,000 a month. Free events stay free.
Do my guests need the app?
No. Guests book, pay and check in on your page in their phone’s browser.
Can I do it from a laptop?
You set up in Catch Host on your phone. If you’re on a laptop, scan the code on the start page to open it there.
What if I’m not sure which format fits?
Message us on WhatsApp and tell us about your night. We’ll suggest one and help you set it up.
